settings.question: Do I really not have to rinse?
settings.answer: Really. Soak the surface, put the hose away, get on with your weekend. Rain and UV do the follow-up over the coming weeks.

settings.question: How long until I see results?
settings.answer: Surface grime starts lifting within days. Moss, mould and lichen brown off and weather away over 2–8 weeks depending on how thick it is and what the weather's doing. It's the opposite of instant — that's why it lasts.

settings.question: Is it safe around plants, kids and pets?
settings.answer: Yes — no acid, no bleach, no chlorine fumes. Used as directed it won't nuke the garden below the fence. Keep everyone off surfaces until they're dry, same as you would with anything.

settings.question: Who actually makes this?
settings.answer: Maximum Wash Ltd — a professional exterior cleaning company with around 20 staff washing buildings across Auckland, Tauranga and Christchurch. Soak n Go is the product we'd use at home.
